newsitem.title: HONG KONG: FIBV announces new members, office-bearers.
newsitem.headline: FIBV announces new members, office-bearers.

text.p: The International Federation of Bourses (FIBV) said on Tuesday the Irish Stock Exchange, Lima Stock Exchange and Lisbon Stock Exchange have been elected members.
The FIBV, which ended its two-day 36th general assembly in Hong Kong on Tuesday, said it had 51 full members, covering over 97 percent of the world stock exchange market capitalization.
Manual Robleda, FIBV vice-president and chairman of the Board of the Bolsa Mexicana de Valores was elected president, FIBV said in a statement.
Robleda would replace Bengt Ryden, president and chief executive officer of the Stockholm Stock Exchange, whose two-year term would end in February 1997.
Edgar Cheng, chairman of the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong, was elected vice president.
Gerald A Lacoste, chief executive officer of the Montreal Stock Exchange was elected chairman of the working committee.
Fernando Opitz, chairman of the Rio de Janeiro Stock Exchange and Roy C Andersen, executive president of the Johannesburg Stock Exchange were elected as members of the executive committee.
